“I usually loosen up before I go for my walk. I do slow shoulder rolls by the window, just taking my time with them. Being by the window gets me looking outside, and then I’m thinking about the sky rather than counting the rolls. I’m an amateur stargazer, so the sky tends to catch my attention.

“I also do calf stretches at the kitchen counter. The counter gives me something to hold on to while I stretch. Those are the main things I do before the walk—the shoulder rolls by the window and the calf stretches in the kitchen. I like to get loosened up first rather than go straight out.”
